slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never explicitly asked about truck capacity or the maximum number of containers allowed per truck. Turn 4 asked only about warehouse-to-port route capacity limits, and Turn 5 was a vague catch-all about additional constraints.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Truck capacity is irrelevant or unconstrained, so the hidden limit of up to 2 containers per truck is not included in the model.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the maximum number of containers per truck before READY_TO_MODEL and then produced a model that omits the truck capacity constraint entirely, while stating that no assumptions remained.

stopping_behavior.rationale: All P0/P1 hidden-slot concerns were resolved before READY_TO_MODEL; the only unresolved hidden slot is H1, which is P2 and does not change the core cost-minimization model.

summary: The agent clarified the main supply-demand, integrality, cost, and route constraints, but missed the low-severity truck capacity hidden fact. The stopping decision is appropriate because no P0/P1 slots remained unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
